key_idea: From the other side of the window, the pattern looks flipped left to right, like in a mirror.
steps: From outside, each row is seen backwards: left and right swap. Top and bottom stay the same.
Top row inside: black, white, black. From outside it is the same: black, white, black.
Middle row inside: black, black, white. From outside: white, black, black.
Bottom row inside: white, black, white. From outside it is the same. That is picture C.

choice_feedback.A: This is the pattern seen from inside. From outside the middle row must be flipped.
choice_feedback.B: From outside the top left square is black, but here it is white.
choice_feedback.D: From outside the top row is black, white, black. Here it is white, black, white.
choice_feedback.E: From outside the top row is black, white, black. Here it is white, black, white.
